paragraphs.source_en: Just as Masamori had wished, the clear moonlight silently illuminated the way as the great host moved in stealth. Toward dawn, dense fog came pouring ceaselessly from the valleys, wrapping their movements so tightly that neither god nor demon could have detected them. By the time the first gunshot echoed through the valleys, the dense fog on the mountaintop had already vanished without a trace.
